title: Dispute choices
decision: The 30 days of BR-11 run from the later of the entry's time and the time the link was made; reasons are 3 to 300 characters; withdrawing is offered on the customer page and not in chat; the refusal names which rule applied; reversing a disputed entry ends the dispute
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 25
rationale: An old entry is new to a customer who has just been linked, and BR-11 counts from being notified
